prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_screen] Pet Desktop Behavior Cheat Sheet Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding screen right after home intro that visually illustrates how the pet interacts with desktop windows and system tray.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_pet_controls_guide"], "home_intro": {"headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion"}}
1: [sign_in, redesign] Account Recovery & Existing Pet Notice Redesign: Redesigns the sign-in screen to include clear account preservation warning components that remind returning users to sign into their original account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Keep Your Pets", "body": "Make sure to use the same account you registered previously to keep all your saved pets and progress.", "replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"role": "sign_in_options", "type": "text", "text": "Sign in with Google or Email", "style": "emphasis"}]}}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Photo Upload Assistant Flow: Introduces a new interactive step-by-step guidance screen before photo upload to assist custom pet generation photo selection.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_photo_guide", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "upload_photos": {"hint": "Select high-resolution photos with clear lighting for best custom pet generation results."}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Intro Screen Redesign: Redesigns the initial story screen using a narrative scroll layout with interactive mascot animation components.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop World", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "asset": "asset:welcome_mascot"}]}}
4: [adoption, incentive] Pet Adoption Name Tag Reward Incentive: Displays an unlocked gold name tag badge component on the adoption certificate screen to celebrate pet adoption.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Gold Name Tag Unlocked", "style": "highlight"}]}}
5: [home, hint] Desktop Visibility Troubleshooting Hint on Waiting Screen: Adds a persistent hint on the waiting screen explaining how to verify screen rendering and system tray placement.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "If your pet does not appear on screen immediately, check if it was minimized to the system tray or secondary monitor."}}
6: [sign_in, copy] Instant Sync Benefit Sign-In Copy: Updates sign-in screen headline and body copy to emphasize automatic cloud backup and cross-device pet restoration.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Pet to the Cloud", "body": "Sign in now to sync your pet settings across all your devices and ensure your companion is never lost."}}
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Hatching Animation on Waiting Screen: Adds an animated pet egg hatching component on the waiting screen while background asset generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:egg_hatching", "style": "playful"}]}}
8: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Launch Notification Prompt: Enables desktop notification toggle on the home intro screen so users get alerted as soon as the pet spawns.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Enable desktop notification when pet arrives on screen", "style": "subtle"}]}}
9: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Selection Purpose Copy: Replaces the choose path headline and body with explicit explanations of premade vs custom pet options.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet", "body": "Pick an instant premade pet companion or create your own custom pet from scratch."}}
